svg.title: TLS in front of relate serve
svg.desc: A driver or an HTTP client connects to a TLS-terminating proxy over an encrypted connection. The proxy runs on the same machine and forwards plaintext to relate serve on 127.0.0.1. relate serve checks the Basic-auth credential on each of its listeners, which share one store.
